		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_authorized value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_available value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_reserved value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_settled value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_conserved value = 1 }
			# Freeze the delivered result identity and candidate boundary before
			# nomination politics can move either one.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_result_owner value = var:zg361_result_case_owner }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_result_subject value = this }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_result_cycle value = var:zg361_result_cycle_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_result_case value = var:zg361_result_case_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_result_state value = var:zg361_result_case_state }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_frozen_grade value = var:zg361_result_grade }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_frozen_reason value = var:zg361_result_grade_reason }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_candidate_eligible value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_frozen_grade >= 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_candidate_eligible value = 1 } }
			# Persistent shelving obligations are consumed once per later review cycle.
			root = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						trigger_if = {
							limit = {
								has_variable = zg361_pp_u_shelving_active
								has_variable = zg361_pp_u_shelving_due_cycle
								has_variable = zg361_pp_u_shelving_last_penalty_cycle
								has_variable = zg361_pp_u_shelving_nominated
							}
							var:zg361_pp_u_shelving_active = 1
							var:zg361_pp_u_shelving_nominated = 0
							var:zg361_review_serial >= var:zg361_pp_u_shelving_due_cycle
							NOT = { var:zg361_pp_u_shelving_last_penalty_cycle = var:zg361_review_serial }
						}
						trigger_else = { always = no }
					}
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_shelving_last_penalty_cycle value = var:zg361_review_serial }
				}
			}
			# Matured #168 observations alter only the next cycle's quota, once and clamped.
			if = {
				limit = { root = { has_variable = zg361_pp_u_next_quota_pending var:zg361_pp_u_next_quota_pending = 1 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_authorized
					value = { value = var:zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_authorized add = root.var:zg361_pp_u_next_quota_delta min = 1 max = 3 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_available value = var:zg361_pp_u_nomination_slot_authorized }
				root = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_next_quota_pending value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_next_quota_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_review_serial }
				}
			}
			# Freeze a distinct filler candidate before #161 can spend real quota/hours.
			remove_variable = zg361_pp_m161_filler_candidate
			save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_pp_u_main_candidate
			root = {
				ordered_vassal = {
					limit = {
						zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
						NOT = { this = scope:zg361_pp_u_main_candidate }
					}
					order_by = stewardship
					position = 0
					save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_pp_u_filler_candidate
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { exists = scope:zg361_pp_u_filler_candidate } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_filler_candidate value = scope:zg361_pp_u_filler_candidate } }
			root = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_portfolio_queue_active value = 1 } }
			zg361_pp_schedule_u_stage_01_effect = yes
			zg361_pp_dispatch_u_stage_01_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_schedule_u_stage_01_effect = {
	zg361_case_kernel_schedule_deadline_effect = {
		OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
		SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
		CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
		CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
		STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
		ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
		DEADLINE_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_u_stage_1_deadline_owner
		DEADLINE_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_u_stage_1_deadline_subject
		DEADLINE_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_u_stage_1_deadline_cycle
		DEADLINE_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_u_stage_1_deadline_case
		DEADLINE_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_u_stage_1_deadline_state
		DEADLINE_DAYS_VAR = zg361_pp_u_stage_1_deadline_days
		DEADLINE_PENDING_VAR = zg361_pp_u_stage_1_deadline_pending
		DEADLINE_EXPIRED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_stage_1_deadline_expired
		TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_u_owner
		TICKET_SUBJECT = this
		TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
		TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial
		TICKET_STATE = 1
		DAYS = 30
		EVENT = zg361pp.4011
	}
}

zg361_pp_dispatch_u_stage_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_u_owner = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
		# Owner-authorized second AI exception: background resolver only, no GUI.
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 }
if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_u_owner = { is_at_war = yes } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 } }
else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_u_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
zg361_pp_m157_core_effect = {
	ROUTE = var:zg361_pp_ai_route
	TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_u_owner
	TICKET_SUBJECT = this
	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 1
}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 }
if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_u_owner = { is_at_war = yes } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 } }
else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_u_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
zg361_pp_m158_core_effect = {
	ROUTE = var:zg361_pp_ai_route
	TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_u_owner
	TICKET_SUBJECT = this
	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 1
}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 }
if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_u_owner = { is_at_war = yes } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 } }
else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_u_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
zg361_pp_m159_core_effect = {
	ROUTE = var:zg361_pp_ai_route
	TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_u_owner
	TICKET_SUBJECT = this
	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 1
}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_u_owner = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
		# Exactly one visible decision is queued.  Each option schedules only the
		# next card, so a 46-card popup storm is structurally impossible.
		save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_subject
		var:zg361_case_u_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_owner }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_cycle value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_case value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_state value = 1 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_mechanism value = 157 }
		var:zg361_case_u_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.157 days = 1 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_u_try_advance_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial

				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active

				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial
				EXPECTED_STATE = 1
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m157_consumed = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m158_consumed = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m159_consumed = 1
		}
		zg361_case_u_advance_01_effect = {
			TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_u_owner
			TICKET_SUBJECT = this
			TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
			TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial
		}
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 } zg361_pp_schedule_u_stage_02_effect = yes
			zg361_pp_dispatch_u_stage_02_effect = yes }
	}
}
